skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 100% ATK DMG to a single target, with a 50% chance to inflict [Specialized Corrode]. [Specialized Corrode]: Deals 100% ATK as Continuous DMG. Disappears after triggering 1 time. After any character acts, transfers to another target that can take DMG.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks a single target with 5 consecutive strikes, dealing 1050% ATK DMG. Can trigger [Evolve], with each target triggering it only once per attack. Has a 75% chance to inflict [Specialized Corrode] on the main target and surrounding allies. Additionally, gains [Specialized Guard] equal to 450% ATK. [Evolve]: Immediately removes the target’s [Unyielding] and Ignore DMG statuses. [Specialized Corrode]: Deals 100% ATK as Continuous DMG. Disappears after triggering 3 times. After any character acts, transfers to another target that can take DMG. [Specialized Guard]: Negates received DMG and overwrites Extra HP effects. The total amount cannot exceed 15 times the unit’s original HP.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Direct DMG 210% > 260% ATK. Still gains [Unyielding], spreads [Corrosion] over the selected area, and self-heals.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: When an enemy receives Continuous DMG, immediately absorbs 60% of the Continuous DMG and deals it as Extra DMG. Only one effect of this type can be effective throughout the battle. Permanently increases own HP.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: When an enemy receives Continuous DMG, immediately absorbs 80% of the Continuous DMG and deals it as Extra DMG. Only one effect of this type can be effective throughout the battle. Permanently increases own HP.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: When an enemy receives Continuous DMG, immediately absorbs 86% of the Continuous DMG and deals it as Extra DMG. Only one effect of this type can be effective throughout the battle. Permanently increases own HP.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Inflicts [Adhesion] on enemies affected by [Specialized Corrode] for 2 rounds. After an ally acts, Deep Sea King has a 60% chance to perform a [Joint Follow-Up] against a random enemy target, up to 1 time per round. [Adhesion]: Prevents the affected unit from initiating [Follow-Up] and [Continuous Follow-Up]. [Joint Follow-Up]: Deep Sea King and allies in the same column activate their Ultimate Skills.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Inflicts [Adhesion] on enemies affected by [Specialized Corrode] for 2 rounds. After an ally acts, Deep Sea King has a 70% chance to perform a [Joint Follow-Up] against a random enemy target, up to 2 times per round. [Adhesion]: Prevents the affected unit from initiating [Follow-Up] and [Continuous Follow-Up]. [Joint Follow-Up]: Deep Sea King and allies in the same column activate their Ultimate Skills.

effects.desc: Control status prevents the target from casting [Follow-up] and [Consecutive Follow-up], usually for 2 turns.
Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
Extra attacks outside of turn (usually after an ally acts) apply a portion of the ultimate's ST and effects to a random target, at no mana cost.
Out of turn attacks deal 70% of the ultimate's damage and effects, without consuming mana, up to 3 times per round.
Extra attack outside of turn. Disabled by [Lock] and [Blind].
Corrosive damage over time effect, each turn dealing damage equal to a percentage of ST (e.g. 300%) to the target.
